title: Fibonacci EA v5.0 Bidirectional Out-of-Sample Walk-Forward Validation (2025)
research_question: Does the bidirectional Fibonacci EA strategy (InpDirection=2, news filter enabled, 10-pip TP1, 15-pip SL) maintain profitability, high win rate (>=70%), and prop firm risk compliance (max equity DD <= 8.0%) on GBPUSD M15 across the unseen 2025 VALIDATION partition?
hypothesis: The statistical edge observed in EXP-0008 (PF 1.39, 79.4% win rate) reflects true market structural tendencies around Fibonacci pullbacks on GBPUSD rather than in-sample curve-fitting, and will produce positive net profit, a profit factor >= 1.20, and max equity drawdown <= 8.0% across the 2025 validation partition.

facts: EXP-0008 demonstrated $577.65 net profit, 1.39 profit factor, 79.38% win rate, and 7.35% max drawdown across the 5-year training partition (2020.01.01 to 2024.12.31).
Research periods configuration config/research_periods.json designates 2025.01.01 to 2025.12.31 as the official VALIDATION partition, untouched by parameter tuning.
inferences: If the strategy's edge is genuine market structure rather than overfitting, out-of-sample performance in 2025 should exhibit similar win rate (>=70%) and remain profitable without breaching the 8.0% prop firm drawdown guard.
evidence: EXP-0008 total_trades=272, profit_factor=1.39, total_net_profit=577.65, win_rate=79.38%, equity_drawdown_maximal_percent=7.35

independent_variables.name: dataset_partition
independent_variables.rationale: Walk-forward out-of-sample evaluation on the unoptimized 2025 market regime.

assumptions: Market microstructure in 2025 maintains similar spread and volatility characteristics on GBPUSD M15.
expected_observations: Total net profit will be positive (> $0).
falsification_conditions: Maximum equity drawdown exceeds 8.0%, violating prop firm risk thresholds.
